headline: A data-native language for reliable backend workflows and simulation-driven applications.

status.summary: The prototype completion bar is closed. The public demo is live with commerce, logistics, and Business Simulator workflows, in-page tester guidance, clearer empty states, visible domain-scoped queue health, hosted smoke checks for reset, transaction, queue, outbox behavior, generic Reux simulation execution, PostgreSQL-backed saved simulation runs, saved-run health checks, public API rate limiting, request counters, and maintenance cleanup tooling. CI smoke automation against PostgreSQL, a reusable monitor for uptime checks with optional webhook alerts, and an operations dashboard support queue and worker health. The current language core has broader transaction control flow, deeper expression typing, alias-remapped reusable filters, null-aware predicate/guard lowering, typed worker contracts, and tighter diagnostics. Simulation domain packs report coverage and suggested assumptions, metrics, scenarios, and objectives, with executable PLOS finance/habit and business workforce/operations examples, deterministic scheduled-change reporting, non-finite formula rejection, generated catalog helpers, and product-facing simulation APIs. Release preflight checks package entrypoints, release docs, roadmap sync, and clean-tree readiness; migrations synthesize rollback SQL for safe reversible schema changes; VS Code diagnostics infer useful symbol and field ranges; and public release planning is documented.
